name: sidebar-collapse
title: Sidebar Collapse
description: A studio sidebar that switches between workspaces.
useCases: In a design workspace, a designer collapses navigation to make room for the canvas while retaining access to both sections.
In a studio workspace, a teammate selects Projects or Collections. The app switches content using the section index.
task: A studio sidebar that switches between workspaces.
behavior: items takes a pair of labels. onSelect provides the index for switching the application view.
